meta.name: init-onecli
meta.description: Install and initialize OneCLI Agent Vault. Migrates existing .env credentials to the vault. Use after /update-nanoclaw brings in OneCLI as a breaking change, or for first-time OneCLI setup.

copy.tagline: 初始化 OneCLI 凭证库并迁移环境变量
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果刚安装 OneCLI 或需要将 .env 凭证迁移到安全库
copy.tagline_en: Initialize OneCLI credential vault and migrate environment variables
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you just installed OneCLI or need to migrate .env credentials to the vault

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会安装 OneCLI、配置 Agent Vault 网关，把 .env 里已有的凭据迁进 vault，再重建并重启服务、查日志确认接管是否生效。
howto.when: 在 /update-nanoclaw 引入 OneCLI 这类破坏性变更之后、首次搭建 OneCLI 时触发；如果你还在用 .env 原生凭据代理，它也会提出切换到 vault。

howto.what_en: Claude installs OneCLI, configures the Agent Vault gateway, migrates existing .env credentials into the vault, then rebuilds and restarts the service and checks the logs.
howto.when_en: Run after /update-nanoclaw brings in OneCLI as a breaking change, for first-time OneCLI setup, or when you still use the native .env credential proxy.
